name: Juice
fix_description: In stake, stakeWeek has no upper bound validation. An attacker can pass an extremely large stakeWeek value to inflate bonus rewards. Add require(stakeWeek <= MAX_STAKE_WEEKS) to cap the staking duration.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, direct exploit: buy tokens, stake once, advance one block, harvest, and sell back. It requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning and no flash loans, complex routing, or multi-contract state manipulation, matching an obvious reward-accounting flaw exploitable in under 30 minutes.
